title: Estoque Inteligente · full redesign
question: Choose the visual direction for every screen. Functions, roles and Portuguese product language stay intact.

options.label: Retail wayfinding
options.lineage: Physical retail signage and shelf identification
options.thesis: Find the product, recognize its position, act with confidence.
options.viewport: Petrol rail at left; search and dense product list at centre; selected stock and large position codes at right.
options.risk: The lime accent must remain reserved for location and selection.

raised.raise: A selected item must remain unmistakable at high density.
Identifiers receive disciplined alignment and consistent emphasis.
Navigation hierarchy must remain clear without decorative containers.
Mobile actions must sit beside the item they affect.
Position codes must stay readable at every viewport.

options.label: Wholesale catalog
options.thesis: A compact, highly familiar product workspace.
options.viewport: Cobalt rail, prominent search, dense stock table and product inspector.
options.risk: Familiar and effective, but close to standard inventory software.

options.label: Data field
options.thesis: Dense numerical stock rows with a monochrome focus state.
options.viewport: Standard rail, search, dense table and selected product.
options.risk: Weak semantic colour and slower scanning for mixed shop roles.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity.
options.kept: A selected item must remain unmistakable at high density.

options.label: Catalog sleeve
options.thesis: Restrained stock catalog with a dark shell and exact identifiers.
options.viewport: Search and stock list with one selected SKU decoded in detail.
options.risk: Tiny labels and low density slow counter service.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity.
options.kept: Identifiers receive disciplined alignment and consistent emphasis.

options.label: Typographic retail
options.thesis: Crisp type hierarchy and flat colour for stock tasks.
options.viewport: Conventional navigation, stock table and a clear action area.
options.risk: Large type spends space needed for product comparisons.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity against retail wayfinding.
options.kept: Navigation hierarchy must remain clear without decorative containers.

options.label: Precision grid
options.thesis: A tightly aligned inventory workspace with modular location labels.
options.viewport: Cobalt rail, aligned search and stock table, selected item inspector.
options.risk: Austere when every screen carries the same density.
options.case: Matches product clarity; less connected to daily retail than physical wayfinding.

options.label: Single-item focus
options.thesis: One selected product receives a focused mobile action area.
options.viewport: Standard rail and compact list alongside a large product inspector.
options.risk: Too little simultaneous information for dense administrative screens.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity across the whole system.
options.kept: Mobile actions must sit beside the item they affect.

options.label: Stock atlas
options.viewport: Standard search and stock table with labelled position markers.
options.risk: Celestial references add distance from everyday stock work.
options.case: Loses audience identification and product clarity.
options.kept: Position codes must stay readable at every viewport.

canonCard.label: Standard inventory software
canonCard.thesis: Conventional neutral admin UI, carefully executed.
canonCard.viewport: Grey rail, white tables, blue primary actions.
